FAQ / 常见问题:
Q: I can't extract some of the files.
A: Try changing the file extension to .rar, or try other extraction tools such as Bandizip.
Q：部分文件解压失败。
A：尝试将后缀名改为rar或使用Bandizip等其他解压工具。

Q: I can’t access the previous gallery.
A: The previous gallery hasn’t been deleted — it’s simply been moved to the inner site. I will not remove this gallery by myself, but if this one also disappears from the main site in the future, it means the same thing has happened to it.
Q：前画廊无法访问。
A：前画廊并没有被删除，只是被移入里站。我不会主动删除当前画廊，但如果未来它也从表站消失，说明它遭遇了同样的情况。

Q: Offline version / Cracked version / Story viewer
A: I am not aware of any such versions and cannot provide any information regarding them.
Q：离线版 / 破解版 / 剧情阅读器
A：我并不知道，也无法提供任何有关信息。

Q: Some animations are 30 FPS.
A: The amount of content to be replaced is quite large, and I do not have the time to replace everything. If there are specific animations you would like me to upgrade to 60 FPS, please specify them in the comments, and I will replace them individually.
Q：部分动画为30帧。
A：需要替换的量比较大，我没有时间全部进行替换。如果你有动画希望我替换为60帧，可以在评论区说明，我会单独替换。
